job.job_description:
What youll do

Design and ship LLM agents end to end: retrieval, tools, evaluation, deployment
Build RAG pipelines over messy real-world client documents
Integrate with WhatsApp Business API, telephony providers and client CRMs
Write evaluation harnesses so we know when quality regresses
Own cost control - model routing, caching, rate limits
Sit in client calls and translate a business problem into a system

What we need

Python and/or TypeScript
Hands-on with OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini APIs
Vector databases and embedding-based retrieval
REST API design and webhook integration
SQL and comfort with production databases

Nice to have

LangGraph or similar agent frameworks
Speech-to-text and TTS pipelines
Indian-language NLP
